study_context.study_scope: Exact-source-reader fresh-input replication across all four causal-versus-normative relation strata.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Source-comparable percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, cause-question/justification-question minus its per-item English comparator, over 24 fresh items with the source's four equally weighted careful-versus-bare strata and exact source readers.
admissibility_gates: authenticated routing still offers exactly 4c90793b0dac00fb8ac214057ade4e5f80552cf484dad1829ed239331e9b1586 immediately before mint
proposal remains visible and measured with no withdrawal, supersession or active author notice; the complete ten-comment discussion was read

source metric, comparator, exact four ordered settlement strata and weights, Mistral/Gemma wrappers and digests, allocation and reader seed, 32-token bound, temperature and serial no-retry execution are preserved
24 wholly fresh scientific items provide six items per required stratum; four target-independent controls run first
each reader receives three marked and three English items within every settlement stratum

every item preserves one byte-identical occurrence reference across its marked and English arms; careful comparators explicitly separate mechanism from warrant while bare comparators preserve why ambiguity
zero exact complete-pair or individual-arm overlap with both recoverable prior comprehension manifests
absolute-gap-v1 reader calibration must clear 0.5 for each reader
zero absent, off-option, truncated or transport-fault cells and full yield are required
every finite supportive, adverse, null, floor-bound or ceiling-bound result files once without retry or outcome selection
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)

planned_sample.reader_arm_balance: each reader 3/3 within every source settlement stratum

settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
